headline: Rezoning of 162 Washington Street from R2 to C1, a $6,005.67 damage claim, and business license hearings.
summary: The meeting includes a second reading of an ordinance to rezone 162 Washington Street from R2 to C1. It also covers a $6,005.67 damage claim, tax abatements and an addition, and license hearings for three businesses and one license holder.
items: Appointment of Olivia Demanche to the Juvenile Hearing Board, term ending September 1, 2029
Department financial reports for July and August 2026 (City Clerk, Fire, Police, Code Enforcement; April, May and June 2026 also included)
Presentation by Planning Director Jim Vandermillen on the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program
License hearing for JFR & Son, LLC, D/B/A La Milonga Bar, 674 Dexter Streerty, Class BV license
Peddler license (new) for Yessenia Rodriguez, D/B/A One Fly Stop, 50 Moorland Ave
Class A Restaurant license (new) for Roca Group, LLC, D/B/A La Receta Colombiana, 913 Dexter Street
Class C Variety license (transfer) for Evelyn Y Quiroa Alonzo, D/B/A Chapines Supermarket Inc., 635 Dexter Street
Tax abatements totaling $4,485.22 (Fall River Pawn Brokers $315.42; City of Central Falls $4,169.80)
Tax addition of $315.42 for Pledge Financial RI
Ordinance to rezone 162 Washington Street from R2 to C1, second reading (Councilperson Rivas Lugo by request)
Claim by Bernice Hernandez, Central Falls, for alleged passenger-side damage from a collision with a police vehicle, estimated at $6,005.67
